Quantum Computing and Information Primer

Quantum computing leverages the principles of quantum mechanics to process information in fundamentally new ways. Research updates are posted at https://quantum-journal.org and www.ibm.com/quantum.

1. Mathematical Foundations

A state vector |ψ> in an N-dimensional Hilbert space is represented as a linear combination of orthonormal basis vectors:

|ψ> = ∑ c_i |i>, where ∑ |c_i|^2 = 1.

3. Error Mitigation Strategies

Zero-noise extrapolation (ZNE) and probabilistic error cancellation (PEC) enable shallow quantum circuit execution on noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) devices.
